# WageReality

> Free, no-signup calculator that computes a person's real hourly wage by subtracting job-related costs and adding job-related time (commute, overtime, decompression) from salary, based on the "real hourly wage" concept in Your Money or Your Life by Vicki Robin and Joe Dominguez.

## Pages
- [WageReality Calculator](https://wagereality.com/): Interactive true hourly wage calculator with formula, worked example, and FAQ.
- [Compare Two Job Offers](https://wagereality.com/compare-job-offers): Side-by-side comparison of two job offers by real hourly wage, accounting for commute, overtime, decompression time, and job costs.
